title: Settings
playOnSelectHint: Moving the selection with ↑ ↓ starts preview immediately.
loopPreviewHint: Sticky. Stays on until you turn it off.
waveformViewHint: Stereo files can show both channels or one summed lane.
coloredWaveformsHint: Bass, mids, and treble tint the wave. Theme sets the hues; overlapping bands mix.
outputDeviceHint: Preview only. Sift never claims your DAW's device exclusively.
bpmRangeHint: Narrower ranges guess octaves less often. The Custom analysis dialog starts from this.
newFilesHint: Roots are watched continuously. Renames and moves update in place.
ignoreListHint: Paths and patterns Sift never indexes.
missingSamplesHint_one: {{count}} indexed file is not on disk right now.
missingSamplesHint_other: {{count}} indexed files are not on disk right now.
holdHoverHint: Hold this key and sweep the list to audition rows under the pointer.
fixedKeys: Fixed keys, not rebindable in v1.
keyRange: Range select · free time on waveform
keyToggle: Toggle a row in the selection
customAnalysisBody_one: Force-runs on the <0>{{count}} selected sample</0>. Existing values are kept unless you tick the matching box.
customAnalysisBody_other: Force-runs on the <0>{{count}} selected samples</0>. Existing values are kept unless you tick the matching box.
overwriteTagsHint: replaces tags Sift detected; yours stay
